About this site

Contact

Have a correction, suggestion, or question about the site? We want to hear it.

Important note

SSO El Paso is NOT the Social Security Administration. We cannot help with your individual Social Security account, applications, benefits, or any official transactions. For those, you must contact the SSA directly:

Official SSA contact

  • SSA national line: 1-800-772-1213 (TTY 1-800-325-0778)
  • Online: ssa.gov
  • My Social Security account: ssa.gov/myaccount
  • El Paso SSA office: 11111 Gateway Blvd W, El Paso, TX 79935
  • SSA office locator: secure.ssa.gov/ICON/main.jsp

Site feedback only

For corrections, suggestions, or questions about this website only, reach us at: hello@ssoelpasotx.com

Do not send personal information such as your Social Security number. We cannot help with individual SSA matters and any such information will be deleted unread.
